hook: Your space station window has a chip in it.
title: A Tiny Speck Cracked the ISS Window
description:
In 2016, a tiny piece of space debris, likely a paint fleck, struck the Cupola window on the International Space Station. It was only thousandths of a millimetre across, yet it left a visible chip.

#Shorts #ISS #SpaceFacts
